content.text: This is a standard Benchmark test case with XPath injection via tainted header value `bar`, concatenated directly into an XPath expression with no sanitization (Base64 encode/decode is a no-op, not a sanitizer).

input.justification: The value from request header "BenchmarkTest00207" is URL-decoded, then passed through Base64 encode+decode (a round-trip that is a no-op and not a sanitizer), and the resulting string 'bar' is directly concatenated into an XPath expression string "/Employees/Employee[@emplid='" + bar + "']" which is then evaluated via XPath.evaluate(). There is no escaping or validation of special XPath characters (like quotes), so a user-controlled header value can break out of the quoted literal and inject arbitrary XPath syntax, leading to XPath injection.
